newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * President Emil Constantinescu called a meeting of the Supreme Defence Council to discuss the country's widespread corruption and organised crime.
* Lower Chamber of Deputies' standing board to meet on January 14 to set up date for a parliament extraordinary session.
* Roman SA truck maker in Brasov increased by 35 percent the prices for its products starting January 7 due to increases in prices of raw materials.
